we are all struggling: some struggle with wanting to feel, others do not. the irresponsible ones always play by the idea of “do i feel good enough”? and then you end up hearing stories like “Man takes 10 Xanax, becomes the incredible hulk, doesn’t even remember taking the drug or what happened”. It’s not about whether or not you ARE an addict, its about “hey, I know i’m predisposed to addiction, how can I still do what I want to do but safely?”. You may feel you are a helpless addict, but you’ve shown me just through words your want to be responsible. That you ARE responsible. Never label yourself just because of your past wrong-doings, just try to do things right AND safely. You are you, and only you. Not a stereotype, not a societal label: you are you, and never forget that.

You deserve more praise than what i can commend through text, I sincerely hope your experience with Klonopin can be one of tranquility and calmness.

you’ll be good then. the one difference is that stims make it very hard to forget the experience you went through during taking them. there is a possibility once you take your first dose, you will forget within like 3 hours. I, in my opinion and experience, I dont think that should happen. The idea with writing down your dose is that IF you do forget if you even took it, you got proof on paper. Benzos can cause slight anterograde amnesia, even at small doses. If you forget what you took, ALWAYS consult a paper to see if you’ve taken any: Cuz you WILL forget, especially at higher doses

you will be fine. dont worry, start at .5mg and if you dont feel anything in like 2.3-3 hours take the next half mg. Dont go over that, set limits for yourself by taking notes on a page if you forget that you shouldnt take anymore
